title: The Importance of Truthfulness and Educational Agreement Between Parents

text_simplified: Parents must be truthful role models for their children, never lying to them, because lying plants bad behavior in the child. They should also agree on a single, stable approach to tarbiyah (upbringing) at home, school, and the masjid, to ensure sound nurturing. If parents differ in their tarbiyah, the child may suffer psychological problems.
